question: Two cars start from the same point and travel in opposite directions. If one car travels at 60 km/hr and the other at 75 km/hr, how far apart will they be after 3 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds.

Relative speed = 60 + 75 = 135 km/hr

Distance covered in 3 hours = Relative speed × Time

Distance = 135 × 3 = 405 km

**∴ The correct answer is 405 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Car 1 (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Speed of Car 2 (S₂) = 75 km/hr

Time (t) = 3 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 Start Point 
• 
• C1 C2 60 km/hr 180 km 75 km/hr 225 km 
 Total Distance = 405 km 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered by Car 1 in 3 hours = 60 × 3 = 180 km

⇒ Distance covered by Car 2 in 3 hours = 75 × 3 = 225 km

⇒ Total distance between them = Distance by Car 1 + Distance by Car 2

⇒ Total distance = 180 + 225 = 405 km

**∴ The correct answer is 405 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two bodies move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂).

Average Speed

If equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, the average speed for the entire journey is given by the formula: 2xy ÷ (x + y).
